# ArtLoka

> ArtLoka is a premium product-discovery website for handcrafted lighting and decor designed and made in India for modern homes, designers, hospitality projects, gifting customers, and trade buyers in the USA, UK, and worldwide.

ArtLoka's website is for discovery, evaluation, and enquiry. Standard purchases continue through the official Etsy listing linked from each product page. Bulk, custom, trade, hospitality, and gifting requirements use structured enquiry forms.

Brand position: Heritage Craftsmanship. Styled for Modern Living.

Use only information visible on public pages. Do not infer live inventory, shipping timelines, certifications, discounts, reviews, materials, electrical specifications, or availability beyond stated product details. Etsy remains the final source for checkout, current price, taxes, shipping, and listing policies.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.artloka.shop/): Product-led introduction to ArtLoka handcrafted lighting and decor.
- [Shop](https://www.artloka.shop/shop): Full public catalogue for product discovery.
- [Craftsmanship](https://www.artloka.shop/craftsmanship): Brand craft story, materials, and making context.
- [About ArtLoka](https://www.artloka.shop/about): Company and brand background.
- [Trade](https://www.artloka.shop/trade): Trade, hospitality, bulk, and gifting enquiry path.
- [Contact](https://www.artloka.shop/contact): General and product-specific enquiry form.

## Product Discovery

- [Lighting collection](https://www.artloka.shop/collections/lighting): Current primary collection covering handcrafted alabaster and brass lighting.
